origin_workflow: RFC specifications, separate technical errata, and named later RFC updates. This is a natural public technical workflow, not a conversational benchmark or personal-life natural-history sample.
authorization_boundary: Delegated source-owner metadata shortlist. Root owns the exact acquisition/input freeze and all corpus reading/model execution. No selected document/erratum body was fetched for this shortlist.
metadata_retention: Selected metadata records and exact origin/revision IDs are retained in this manifest. raw_response_sha256 hashes the fetched official metadata response; full response bytes were not added to the worktree. Original RFC/erratum body hashes remain null until Root freezes acquisition and actually obtains them.

body_independent_filters: Official errata Summary Table has Verified Technical record; status is metadata, not an evaluated method outcome.
Original publication April2015 through December2025 inclusive, after TLP5 effective date.
IETF stream and actual nonempty working-group acronym; exclude NON WORKING GROUP.
Exclude every conservative component touching incidental preview-exposed RFC identities.
preregistration.group_policy: Union all known update/obsolete edges across the complete RFC index, then all same actual working-group members, transitively. One origin per resulting component. Add any semantic/template/derivation equivalence discovered during later development curation; never split to hit32.
preregistration.rank_rule: Ascending hexadecimal SHA256(UTF8(milai-v13.4-rfc-origin-v1: + canonical RFC ID)), retaining first eligible origin per component. First32 are primary; remaining7 are ordered reserves. No corpus length, question, gold, model result or Ours-win criterion enters selection.
preregistration.reservation_policy: Every selected component and every known derivative is development-reserved before acquisition; preserve the reservation even if primary is not run. These sources cannot later be promoted to unseen T2/T3/transfer by changing IDs.
preregistration.replacement_policy: At most take the next reserve for a documented license failure, duplicate/derivation merge or true task-inapplicability discovered before running methods; retain the excluded source and reason in the log. Do not replace because B1/B2 succeeds, a desired8-per-stratum quota is difficult, or M loses. Exhaustion leaves32 target unmet and calls for a separately preregistered natural-source expansion or explicitly grouped diagnostic supplement.

incidental_exposure.search_query: site:rfc-editor.org errata search table RFC index XML has_errata
incidental_exposure.scope: Search results unexpectedly included some concrete erratum text in previews. No linked erratum full record was opened. All eight identities and their conservative components were excluded prospectively from candidate selection.
incidental_exposure.license_page_observation: TLP5 itself mentions correction of its license name. That licensing document is not a T0 candidate.
incidental_exposure.prior_unrecorded_manual_or_pretraining_e: UNKNOWN; no claim of model pretraining novelty or complete historical human exposure exclusion.

license_and_provenance.basis: Official reuse documentation permits unmodified copying/distribution under IETF Trust provisions; TLP5 describes attribution/notice conditions and limits modifications outside the IETF process. This is not an MIT/CC-BY claim.
license_and_provenance.planned_use: Preserve unmodified originals with notice/author attribution; any research questions/annotations stored separately. Do not edit source RFC text or label a counterfactual as the original.
license_and_provenance.erratum_specific_license_scope: PENDING; do not infer independent blanket relicensing from RFC license alone. Keep source URLs and provenance; no corpus release until checked.
license_and_provenance.licensing_gate: Metadata supports a concrete acquisition route, not final dataset redistribution approval.

supported_by_metadata: Actual historical public technical corrections have persistent RFC and erratum IDs.
Original RFCs stay unchanged; separate errata and later RFC versions permit testing statement history versus corrected specification content.
Some candidates have named later RFC changes; those are recorded without deciding semantic effective time.
not_proved: A verified erratum always creates query-relevant relation ambiguity.
The four8-history T0 strata can all be filled.
32 candidates will remain independent after semantic derivation audit.
All original technical rules can be evaluated by the existing model/Reader.
All relevant evidence fits32 candidates or2048 tokens.
fit_assessment.truth_boundary: Use specification/document claims only. Do not infer deployed implementation behavior, retroactive business authorization, or real-world effective dates from publication/report dates.
fit_assessment.time_boundary: reported_at_date describes historical report metadata; current Verified status does not prove it was verified on that date. Actual observed_at is acquisition/ingestion time. Verification transition time and semantic valid_time are unknown unless later allowed source text explicitly supports them.
fit_assessment.normal_control_policy: Preserve explicit nonambiguous corrections and short histories; if full correction chains solve them, record that result and reconsider G1 rather than manufacturing ambiguity.
fit_assessment.shared_workflow_limit: All candidates share a standards-document/errata workflow and public editorial formatting. WG/update clustering reduces known provenance overlap; it does not establish cross-workflow generalization or independent scenario-template truth.

root_next_acquisition_contract: Freeze manifest identity/hash, selected32 primary components, use=development, source cutoff and allowed views before first body read.

Acquire only the named original RFC and selected erratum pages plus predeclared relevant update-chain documents, preserving raw bytes/hash/HTTP retrievalUTC and source IDs; log absent/changed metadata. Status and report-date metadata are not gold runtime labels.

Inspect individual copyright/notice and erratum source terms; preserve raw text and make research annotations separate. Record unresolved license scope without silently approving corpus redistribution.

Find actual subject/time/scope evidence from permitted original sections, preserve Unicode spans and full-source hashes. Record all discovered derivation/template links and merge source components before final cohort count.

Design four natural queries per admitted history only after source history formation boundary is fixed, keeping evaluator gold and evidence-set labels physically separate. Archive-insufficient labels require evidence-relative reasoning, not assumed hidden world truth.

Retain all audit failures and inapplicable sources; reserve substitutions follow the preregistered metadata order. Diagnostic supplements require independent-origin/template records and separate natural-incidence reporting.
Run no new method comparisons before N0/N1/G0-Read evidence is frozen and reviewed by Root.
